notes.title: Blood Lily Sequel, Killers Can’t Sink a Yuri Ship, Opens Store Page
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33644753/ec6120c1afb96b83ec5e3ebff6a3007e2f824f85.png[/img]

The store page for Blood Lily: Killers Can’t Sink a Yuri Ship, the sequel to Blood Lily Ghoststories, is now live. Players can wishlist the game ahead of its upcoming release.

Blood Lily: Killers Can’t Sink a Yuri Ship is a B-horror mystery comedy adventure game. Lily’s romantic getaway with her crush Sally takes a bloody turn when a string of killers crashes their trip. Refusing to back down, Lily declares war: “How dare you come between Sally and me!”

With a blend of humor and horror, the game continues the Blood Lily series’ tradition of intertwining yuri with unexpected narrative twists.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3863090/

notes.title: 星光的引導－世界的巡禮者 商店頁面正式公開
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3102010


[h1]星光的引導－世界的巡禮者[/h1] 
商店頁面正式公開，加入願望清單就是現在！

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41570851/fe4da34673cf2459fb6a64cf436adc4bd96e9aea.jpg[/img]


[h1]Story[/h1]
一名來自小村落的少女，拿起星星的手杖，跟著伙伴踏上了旅程。 在旅程中會遇到各種冒險和挑戰，究竟會有什麼在等待著少女呢？

[h1]Character[/h1]
艾莉絲：來自一個小村落的少女，對於這個世界充滿好奇心而踏上旅程

莫爾摩：為了觀察人間界而從魔界過來的「幽靈」少女

斯碧涅爾：代表充實、好奇心、突出為印象的寶石，擁有尖晶石之力的少女

凱洛拉伊：習慣一個人孤獨的少女，遵從自己的野望流浪於世界各處

遊戲中還有更多的角色等著玩家去發掘...


[h1]Feature[/h1]
■ 傳統的回合制RPG遊戲，過程中會有許多角色加入隊伍

■ 豐富的技能與各種敵人，讓玩家可以思考打法與策略

■ 許多可愛的角色，可以跟她們互動

notes.notes:

[code]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/RMA]關注RMAsia鑑賞家[/url]
[/code]

[h1]STORY[/h1]
《The Lands of Rest1》 : Part 1 is a story-driven game that narrates the life of Bipara in the Underground Realm.

"In the days of the past, I had a complete family and lived a simple, happy life. However, one day, I lost everything."
A sudden accident took away Bipara’s parents and home. The only thing left behind by his father—the family heirloom, a crystal from the legendary Underground Realm—became his only support.
Guided by this crystal, Bipara arrives in the Underground Realm.

Why did this crystal guide him here in the first place?
The mystery of the story will slowly unfold as the plot progresses —


[h1]DEMO[/h1]
The demo version allows you to play through chapters U0 to U2, with a playtime of approximately 2 hours.

The full version of the game will eventually have 6 chapters (U0 to U5). Below is an estimate of the length for each chapter and the range covered in the demo.
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41570851/599246b6c5209708ae57212ae4c6a07f0358c301.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3461310/1_Demo/

If you’re interested in the game, please consider adding it to your wishlist. The full version is scheduled for release in Q4 2025 (by the end of the year).

notes.title: Peacemaker: Bloody Emperor Delayed Release
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33644753/9268e204b974b5aa9db85827ca7b8da090f44418.png[/img]

We apologize for disappointing those who were looking forward to Peacemaker: Bloody Emperor. After careful consideration, we have decided to delay the release of this game in order to achieve the quality we are striving for.

Originally, we planned to develop Peacemaker: Glorious Princess and Peacemaker: Bloody Emperor in parallel and release the former in May 2024 and the latter in September. [b][u]Glorious Princess will be released on schedule[/u][/b], but our expectations for the quality of these two games are much higher than we originally thought. Therefore, we have decided to develop Bloody Emperor steadily rather than in a rush.

Finally, we apologize again, but we also promise to make Peacemaker: Bloody Emperor the best it can be.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1977070/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2548910/
